_readme: The apps in the slide projector's show, in order. One entry is one slide and one word in the cloud. `app` is owner/filename on this server (the picture is taken at /v1/apps/<app>?mode=inline and the sentence comes from the catalogue unless `line` is given); `url` is any other page; `settle` is how long the page takes to fill before the shutter, in milliseconds; `detailOf` opens that app's own page inside the catalogue before the shutter. `name` and `line` are one string or {en, fi, es}. pnpm projector:shots --only apps takes the pictures into apps-<id>.png.

line.en: Every app on this server on one page: what it does, who made it, how it was built, what it earns.
line.fi: Jokainen tämän palvelimen appi yhdellä sivulla: mitä se tekee, kuka teki, miten se rakentui, mitä se tuottaa.
line.es: Cada aplicación de este servidor en una página: qué hace, quién la hizo, cómo se construyó, qué gana.

name.es: La página propia de una aplicación

line.en: Eighteen sections about one app: where its work lives, its versions, its skills, its audit trail, its money.
line.fi: Kahdeksantoista osiota yhdestä apista: missä sen työ on, versiot, taidot, lokit, rahat.
line.es: Dieciocho secciones sobre una aplicación: dónde vive su trabajo, sus versiones, sus habilidades, su registro, su dinero.
